title: Liner Notes
description: A song's liner notes, synced to the track like lyrics. As it plays, each section's note fills word by word in white while the notes ahead wait in the cover's deep ink, all on one flat colour pulled from the artwork. Scroll or drag to look around, click a note to jump to that part of the song.
intent: The synced-lyrics view rebuilt around who played what and when: credits and recording facts as the time-synced line, with weight and colour carrying the hierarchy.
